title: [review] CCA gate ignores lichen_csma_tx_complete result; TX_ALLOWED can strand after concurrent cancel/lock
description: P2, wave-3 review. link_cca.c:111 does (void)lichen_csma_tx_complete(&ctx->csma, 0); return 0. If tx_complete returns -EBUSY (csma lock held by concurrent snapshot/TX) phase stays TX_ALLOWED -> all future gate calls -EALREADY -> -EPROTO wedge (same class as the positive-cad_status P1). If cancel was requested tx_complete returns CANCELLED (positive) and the gate still returns 0, authorizing TX after cancellation. Fix: check the result; on failure lichen_csma_reset(&ctx->csma) or map CANCELLED -> -ECANCELED. Add test if cheap (cancel during gate).
close_reason: Fixed in link_cca.c TX_ALLOWED case: lichen_csma_tx_complete result is now checked. LICHEN_CSMA_RESULT_CANCELLED -> return -ECANCELED (cancellation wins, TX not authorized; CANCELLED phase self-recovers on next start). Negative result -> best-effort lichen_csma_reset(&ctx->csma) then propagate the error (reset cannot fully fix a contended lock but prevents a stranded TX_ALLOWED phase from wedging once the lock frees). Test NOT added: the two failure branches need an actor between cad_complete (TX_ALLOWED) and tx_complete, or a concurrently held csma lock — no single-threaded injection point exists in the link_ctx gate harness (cancel-during-gate would need a new hook in link_cca.c); tests/csma/main.c was outside this task's file allowlist. Discovered while closing sibling c4m7.
